task: Shared quick-answer style for the 55 answer-first leads (polish-2026-11-13-answer-leads-nexus-obbba.md, item 3)

errors.what: First full run of platform/pages tests: 158 failures, all from the new post's description (170 chars). I had already shortened it, but the suite read the file before the edit. A rerun after the fix was clean.

doc_friction.issue: It says to start the build in run_in_background; I added my own '&' inside, so the task notification fired at once and I had to poll the log for DONE separately. A one-line example of the exact command would prevent this.
The front-matter checker is platform/ci/check_post_frontmatter.py. I guessed check_post_front_matter.py first, because no guide names the script; the writing guide could link it.

deviations.why: It asks for a contrast.mjs and Lighthouse measurement. Instead I measured lead heights, first-input depth and sideways scroll with Playwright on 8 pages, and bounded contrast analytically (a 5% currentColor tint) with a test that caps the tint at 8%.
deviations.did: The report says contrast.mjs was not run on a rebuilt dist
deviations.result: Change shipped; the contrast claim is stated as bounded, not measured

notes: Measured before/after with Playwright against dist/, built pre-change, with ANSWER_LEAD_CSS injected for 'after'. Lead cost: 0-32 px at 390 px, ~20 px at 1280 px (Etsy 44). No sideways scroll. Targeted tests (answer-lead-style, answer-lead, jump-row): 66/66 pass. Full platform/pages suite after the fix: 1631 tests, 1605 pass, 0 fail (rest skipped).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: A front-end dev would spend about 3 h writing a shared CSS rule, measuring 8 pages at two widths, writing a test and writing it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
